fields.description: The engine/discipline this category config belongs to (e.g. 'Electrical').
fields.label: Discipline

fields.description: The category id within the discipline (e.g. 'wiring_cabling'). Part of the composite read index [discipline, category_id]; the read endpoint keys on (discipline, category_id).
fields.label: Category Id

fields.description: The whole per-category config blob: attribute_definitions (the pickable dimensions), the derivation pipelines (structured steps with conditions + rounding), normalization_rule, and display metadata. JSON (read-whole, UI-driven) per the app's stated rule. The pipelines are STORED CONFIG interpreted downstream -- RM-1 stores them faithfully; no interpreter ships this slice.
fields.label: Config

fields.description: The source workbook this config was decoded from (e.g. the Electrical pricing xlsx).
fields.label: Source Workbook

fields.description: One shared batch id per import event (prefix 'rmbulk-'), identical to the items loaded in the same event. A --replace re-import deactivates the prior batch and mints a new one (freeze-and-supersede).
fields.label: Import Batch

fields.description: Whether this config row is the live/current version. A --replace re-import sets active=0 on the prior batch. The read endpoint returns the active config ONLY.
fields.label: Active
